research_question: How does efficient causal graph repair change as maximum edit budget and edit-cost preference vary?

cohorts.unit: graph-corruption draw conditional on one fixed DRF DGP and training frame

e1.d_unit_level_uncertainty: NOT_RECOMPUTED: per-G0 rows and raw response vectors were unavailable
e1.pareto_dominance: no greater mean atomic edge edits and no greater mean loss/regret, with at least one strict improvement; retain exact ties

e2.budget_cap_rule: max(4, maximum initial FN+FP+REV+UNRES burden within the original cohort)
e2.b0_b4_replay_match: all 22,440 original SCM-policy-budget results: graph hash, edits, action and analytic regret
e2.input_restoration: hash-identical deterministic restoration checked against original truth, observations, task and G0 bindings

e3.action_grid: unchanged five original C training-derived actions

analysis_limits: Research E is post-hoc and does not replace any frozen Research C or Research D primary or secondary analysis.
Research C regret and Research D standardized tracking loss are never pooled.
Research D 200 units are not independent SCMs.
Atomic edge-edit count is not labor, time, money, deployment or safety cost.
No claim of manufacturing intervention validation or deployment efficacy.
